Ordinance

BE IT ORDAINED BY THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CHICAGO

Section 1. Title 17 of the Municipal Code of Chicago, the Chicago Zoning
Ordinance, is hereby amended by the changing all of the RT-4 Residential Two-Flat,
Townhouse and Multi-Unit District symbols and indications as shown on Map No. 2-
J in the area bound by:

The public alley next north of and parallel to West Flourney; a line 123.5 feet west of
and parallel to South Central Park Avenue; a line 120 feet north of and parallel
to West Flourney Avenue; and a line 173.5 feet west of and parallel to South
Central Park Avenue

to those of C1-1 Neighborhood Commercial District.

Section 2. This ordinance shall be in force and effect from and after its passage and
due publication.

Common Address of Property: 3614 W. Flourney Avenue, Chicago, Illinois.

G in the area bound by:

and parallel to South Central Park Avenue: a line 120 feet north of West Flournoy
Avenue; and a line 173.84 feet west of and parallel to South Central Park Avenue

to those of C1-1 Neighborhood Commercial District.

Section 2. This ordinance shall be in force and effect from and after its passage and

Common Address of Property: 3614 W. Flournoy Avenue, Chicago, Illinois.
